title: Class note
description: docs/_meta/classes/<name>.md frontmatter: one class of note in a docs vault. The note's body is its template.

class.description: Class notes are notes of class class.

name.description: The name notes use in their class property.

division.description: One of the six fixed divisions.

folder.description: Where its notes live, under docs/, inside its division.

thing.description: True when notes describe something that exists: they need a source, one note per source.

statuses.description: Statuses allowed in the live folder; empty means no status.

archive.description: Statuses that must sit under governance/archive/.
